name: sub_0017EED5
note: MSVC CRT _frnd: fld qword [esp+4]; frndint; return st0. floor() (0x17C61D) and ceil() (0x17C54F) call it between _ctrlfp RC=down/up and the restore, so it must round under the guest control word. The gen tree lifted its frndint as rint(), which is host-nearest; x87_lift.c answers it until the tree is regenerated with the fixed lifter.
